territories.name: Liechtenstein
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. Liechtenstein is not a Member State and levies a value added tax of its own under the Mehrwertsteuergesetz of 22 October 2009 (LR 641.20), which follows the Swiss law under the treaty of 28 October 1994 with Switzerland: article 25 sets the rates, article 23 exempts exports, article 35 sets the quarterly return and article 58 has it filed with the Steuerverwaltung within 60 days of the period.
